newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian cabinet meeting starts, Chubais present.
newsitem.headline: Russian cabinet meeting starts, Chubais present.

text.p: A meeting of Russia's cabinet started at 3 p.m. (1200 GMT) with President Boris Yeltsin's chief-of-staff Anatoly Chubais present.
It was not clear whether Chubais was there as a representative of Yeltsin or whether he was going to join the cabinet.

Yeltin has promised a cabinet reshuffle, and Kremlin sources say Chubais could be appointed first deputy prime minister with a broad role supervising the economy and combatting economic crime and corruption.
Earlier on Thursday Chubais said Yeltsin had not yet decided whether to transfer him to the government.
